args.script:
import glob,os,re,collections
files=sorted(glob.glob('**',recursive=True))
files=[f for f in files if os.path.isfile(f)]
print(files)
allw=collections.Counter()
for f in files:
    s=open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    print(f,'zebra' in s.lower(), len(s))
    allw.update(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z']+", s.lower()))
print(allw.most_common(60))
